name: authentik
description: Open-source identity provider. Single sign-on with OIDC, SAML, LDAP and more.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database, uploaded media, certificates, email templates, secret keys and settings.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: authentik sign-in pages, admin interface and API, published on host as 6123

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: ADMIN_EMAIL
variables.description: The email for the admin account (akadmin). Put your own email here. Only used on the first start.

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: The password for the admin account (akadmin). Leave it blank and the app makes a random one on first start. It is shown in the app log and saved in the data folder. Or type your own. Only used on the first start; change it later in authentik.
